pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with highly irregular, serrated edge gradients. The boundaries exhibit frequent, fine-scale pixel-level protrusions and indentations, creating a star-like or jagged appearance rather than smooth curves.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative space. Pathways vary in pixel thickness, narrowing at junctions and widening along the lateral flank. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-directional intersections forming a cohesive topological grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the neck-to-shoulder transition showing a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette. Individual hair bundles create a repetitive, brush-like 1D contour against the desaturated background.
